column1: # The output roots differ by cohort for historical reasons -- the pilot was
# first and wrote to refbias/p<n> directly, later cohorts got their own
# subtree. Declaring them here rather than deriving them from the cohort name
# is deliberate: a guessed path is how one cohort's calls get scored against
# another cohort's outputs, and that mistake has been made in this project.
# passes: which passes this cohort has been or should be run through.
# workprefix: scratch path prefix; a pass appends its own name, so
#   refbias/work/scale_p1. Declared, not derived, because the two existing
#   cohorts do not share a convention and guessing invented a path that does
